RFI-2.1.title: Period of cover
RFI-2.1.exact_text: Cover under this policy applies to treatment received between the effective date and the expiry date shown in the schedule, provided the policy is in force on the date of treatment.

RFI-2.2.title: Insured members
RFI-2.2.exact_text: Only persons named as insured members in the schedule are covered, and only for treatment received while their individual cover is in force.

RFI-3.1.title: Outpatient benefit
RFI-3.1.exact_text: We will pay for outpatient consultations, physiotherapy and treatment prescribed by a registered medical practitioner, subject to the limits and cost-sharing shown in Section 5.

RFI-3.2.title: Medical necessity
RFI-3.2.exact_text: Treatment is covered only when it is medically necessary for the diagnosis documented by the treating practitioner.

RFI-4.1.title: Waiting period
RFI-4.1.exact_text: Outpatient benefits are payable only for treatment received after 30 days of continuous cover from the member's cover start date, except for treatment following an accident.

RFI-5.1.title: Annual outpatient limit
RFI-5.1.exact_text: The maximum we will pay for all outpatient benefits per member in a policy year is USD 1,500.00.

RFI-5.2.title: Outpatient cost-sharing
RFI-5.2.exact_text: No deductible or coinsurance applies to outpatient benefits. The member pays a fixed copay of USD 25.00 for each outpatient visit.

RFI-6.1.title: Cosmetic treatment exclusion
RFI-6.1.exact_text: We will not pay for cosmetic or aesthetic treatment performed to change appearance where there is no documented medical indication.

RFI-7.2.title: Claim evidence
RFI-7.2.exact_text: Each outpatient claim must be supported by a medical report from the treating practitioner stating the diagnosis and the treatment provided. We may defer assessment until this report is received.

CSR-2.1.exact_text: Reimbursement claims for standard medical treatment (inpatient or outpatient) must be submitted within 60 days from the last date of treatment or the discharge date.
